The merged fit of the drift diffusion model (`analysis/models/ddm5.rds`, from
`./hpc pull`; `ddm5` in `analysis/server/models.R`) at the population level:
how the groups differ on every parameter and derived quantity, for each
illusion, across illusion strength, and what that predicts for the RT
distributions; then the group differences averaged over the whole design, the
marginal slopes of strength and difficulty, and the illusion magnitude index.
The participant level, and what age and the questionnaires account for, is in
`4_ddm_correlates.qmd`. Render from the repo root (about 10 min; it needs
cogmod ≥ 0.3.6):

```bash
quarto render analysis/3_ddm_groups.qmd
```

The model (`cogmod_ddm`) has five parameters: the drift rate, the boundary
separation, the start point (`bias`), the non-decision time and the
trial-to-trial drift SD (`sigmadrift`); the start point's and the
non-decision time's trial-to-trial ranges are fixed at 0. `dec(Error)` puts
the error on the upper boundary, so the drift is negative when the correct
response is favoured, and the start point is a share of the boundary from the
correct one (above 0.5: closer to the error). Discriminability (`delta`) is
the drift towards the correct response, −drift.

Unless said otherwise, everything is at `Task_Difficulty = 0` (mid
difficulty). `poutlier` has no Group term, so it is the same in every group
and left out of the comparisons. The quantities, their scales and the
contrasts come from `analysis/server/marginals.R`; see there. The numbers
behind the figures are written to `analysis/results/ddm_groups_*.csv` and
`ddm_ppc_*.csv`.

## Loading

```{r}
library(brms)
library(modelbased)
library(ggplot2)

# Runs from analysis/ (quarto) or from the repo root (interactively).
root <- if (dir.exists("server")) "." else "analysis"
source(file.path(root, "server/models.R"))
source(file.path(root, "server/marginals.R"))

stopifnot(utils::packageVersion("cogmod") >= "0.3.6")
fit_file <- Sys.getenv("IGSA_FIT", unset = file.path(root, "models/ddm5.rds"))
out_dir <- file.path(root, "results")
dir.create(out_dir, showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)

m <- readRDS(fit_file)
```

```{r}
# Population-level convergence, the part the marginals below rest on.
b <- posterior::summarise_draws(
  as_draws_array(m, variable = "^b_", regex = TRUE),
  "rhat", "ess_bulk", "ess_tail"
)
np <- nuts_params(m)
divergent <- sum(np$Value[np$Parameter == "divergent__"])
```

Fit: `r basename(fit_file)`, `r nchains(m)` chains, `r ndraws(m)` draws,
`r divergent` divergent transitions. Population-level coefficients
(`r nrow(b)`): max Rhat `r sprintf("%.3f", max(b$rhat))`
(`r sum(b$rhat > 1.01)` above 1.01), min bulk ESS `r round(min(b$ess_bulk))`,
min tail ESS `r round(min(b$ess_tail))`.

## Draws

```{r}
grid <- igsa_grid(m, strength = round(seq(-1, 1, by = 0.1), 2), difficulty = 0)
d <- igsa_draws(m, grid)
poutlier <- d$poutlier
d$poutlier <- NULL

means <- igsa_summary(d, grid)
write.csv(means, file.path(out_dir, "ddm_groups_means.csv"), row.names = FALSE)
contrasts <- igsa_summary(igsa_contrasts(d, grid))

# The two numbers per contrast that the curves come down to: the difference
# with no illusion, and the difference in the effect of the illusion.
at0 <- grid$Illusion_Strength == 0
base <- igsa_summary(igsa_contrasts(lapply(d, function(x) x[, at0, drop = FALSE]), grid[at0, ]))
base$Measure <- "No illusion (strength 0)"
slope <- igsa_summary(igsa_contrasts(igsa_slopes(d, grid, from = 0, to = 1)))
slope$Measure <- "Effect of the illusion (strength 0 to 1)"
cols <- c("Contrast", "Illusion_Type", "Quantity", "Measure", "Median", "CI_low", "CI_high", "pd")
summary_tab <- rbind(base[cols], slope[cols])
write.csv(summary_tab, file.path(out_dir, "ddm_groups_contrasts.csv"), row.names = FALSE)
```

```{r}
# Labels and colours
quantities <- c(
  mu = "drift (towards the error)",
  boundary = "a: boundary separation",
  bias = "w: start point",
  ndt = "Non-decision time (s)",
  sigmadrift = "sv: trial-to-trial drift SD",
  delta = "v = -drift: discriminability",
  perror = "P(error)"
)
parameters <- c("mu", "boundary", "bias", "ndt", "sigmadrift")
derived <- c("delta", "perror")
illusions <- c(Ebbinghaus = "Ebbinghaus", MullerLyer = "Müller-Lyer",
               VerticalHorizontal = "Vertical-Horizontal")

# Never is the reference, in neutral grey; each contrast against it takes the
# other group's hue, and Recent - Past the next categorical slot.
group_col <- c(Never = "#7a7a75", Past = "#2a78d6", Recent = "#eb6834")
contrast_col <- c("Past - Never" = "#2a78d6", "Recent - Never" = "#eb6834",
                  "Recent - Past" = "#1baf7a")
contrast_lty <- c("Past - Never" = "solid", "Recent - Never" = "solid",
                  "Recent - Past" = "22")

tidy <- function(x) {
  x$Quantity <- factor(quantities[x$Quantity], levels = quantities)
  x$Illusion_Type <- factor(illusions[as.character(x$Illusion_Type)], levels = illusions)
  if (!is.null(x$Contrast)) x$Contrast <- factor(x$Contrast, levels = names(contrast_col))
  x
}
means <- tidy(means)
contrasts <- tidy(contrasts)
summary_tab <- tidy(summary_tab)

theme_igsa <- theme_minimal(base_size = 10) +
  theme(
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.major = element_line(colour = "#ebebe8", linewidth = 0.3),
    strip.text = element_text(face = "bold", hjust = 0),
    strip.text.y = element_text(angle = 0),
    legend.position = "top",
    legend.justification = "left",
    plot.background = element_rect(fill = "white", colour = NA),
    plot.caption = element_text(colour = "#6b6b66", hjust = 0)
  )

caption <- paste0(
  "Population level, mid task difficulty. Lines: posterior medians; bands: 95% intervals.\n",
  "Strength: + pushes towards the error (conflicting), - towards the right answer (facilitating)."
)
```

## Each group's surface

```{r}
#| fig-width: 9

# as discriminability only.
ggplot(means[means$Quantity != quantities[["mu"]], ], aes(Illusion_Strength, Median)) +
  geom_ribbon(aes(ymin = CI_low, ymax = CI_high, fill = Group), alpha = 0.15) +
  geom_line(aes(colour = Group), linewidth = 0.7) +
  facet_grid(Quantity ~ Illusion_Type, scales = "free_y", switch = "y",
             labeller = labeller(Quantity = label_wrap_gen(20))) +
  scale_colour_manual(values = group_col) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = group_col) +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = c(-1, 0, 1)) +
  labs(x = "Illusion strength", y = NULL, colour = NULL, fill = NULL,
       title = "DDM parameters per group", caption = caption) +
  theme_igsa + theme(strip.placement = "outside")
```

## Predicted RT distributions

What the population-level parameters imply for the responses themselves: the
density of correct responses above the axis and of errors below it (as
negative heights). Each is the diffusion's defective density (the first
passage at that boundary), so the area under a curve is the proportion of
responses of that kind, and the error curve's area is the P(error) above. The
lines are posterior means of the density, the bands 95% intervals, from 500
evenly spaced draws. Each row has its own y scale, so compare heights within a
row, not between rows. The outlier component is left out: at the population
level it is `r sprintf("%.2f%%", 100 * median(poutlier))` of responses, the
same in every group.

```{r}
# Defective first-passage densities, from cogmod, for draws x time points.
ddm_density <- function(t, p, response) {
  n <- length(p$mu)
  matrix(cogmod::dcogmod_ddm(rep(t, each = n), drift = p$mu, boundary = p$boundary, bias = p$bias,
                             ndt = p$ndt, response = response, sigmadrift = p$sigmadrift),
         nrow = n)
}

strength_lab <- c("-1" = "Facilitating (strength -1)", "0" = "No illusion (strength 0)",
                  "1" = "Conflicting (strength +1)")
rt <- seq(0.01, 3, by = 0.01)
draw_ids <- round(seq(1, ndraws(m), length.out = 500))
cells <- which(grid$Illusion_Strength %in% c(-1, 0, 1))

dens <- do.call(rbind, lapply(cells, function(j) {
  p <- lapply(d, function(x) x[draw_ids, j])
  f <- list(
    Correct = ddm_density(rt, p, 0),
    Error = ddm_density(rt, p, 1)
  )
  do.call(rbind, lapply(names(f), function(r) {
    # Errors hang below the axis.
    s <- if (r == "Error") -1 else 1
    q <- s * apply(f[[r]], 2, stats::quantile, probs = c(0.025, 0.975))
    data.frame(grid[j, c("Group", "Illusion_Type", "Illusion_Strength")], Response = r,
               RT = rt, Density = s * colMeans(f[[r]]),
               CI_low = pmin(q[1, ], q[2, ]), CI_high = pmax(q[1, ], q[2, ]),
               row.names = NULL)
  }))
}))
dens$Illusion_Type <- factor(illusions[as.character(dens$Illusion_Type)], levels = illusions)
dens$Strength <- factor(strength_lab[as.character(dens$Illusion_Strength)], levels = strength_lab)

# P(error) per group, printed in the empty top right, as the error curve is
# often too flat to see. The posterior mean, which is the area of the mean
# density.
perr <- data.frame(grid[cells, c("Group", "Illusion_Type", "Illusion_Strength")],
                   PError = colMeans(d$perror[, cells]), row.names = NULL)
perr$Illusion_Type <- factor(illusions[as.character(perr$Illusion_Type)], levels = illusions)
perr$Strength <- factor(strength_lab[as.character(perr$Illusion_Strength)], levels = strength_lab)
perr$Label <- sprintf("%s: %.1f%%", perr$Group, 100 * perr$PError)
shown <- dens$RT <= 2.5
top <- tapply(dens$CI_high[shown], dens$Strength[shown], max)
height <- top - tapply(dens$CI_low[shown], dens$Strength[shown], min)
row <- as.character(perr$Strength)
perr$y <- top[row] - 0.1 * height[row] * (as.integer(perr$Group) - 1)
```

```{r}
#| fig-width: 9
#| fig-height: 7.5

ggplot(dens, aes(RT, Density)) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, colour = "#9a9a95", linewidth = 0.4) +
  geom_ribbon(aes(ymin = CI_low, ymax = CI_high, fill = Group,
                  group = interaction(Group, Response)), alpha = 0.15) +
  geom_line(aes(colour = Group, group = interaction(Group, Response)), linewidth = 0.7) +
  geom_text(data = perr, aes(x = 2.5, y = y, label = Label, colour = Group),
            hjust = 1, size = 2.8, show.legend = FALSE) +
  facet_grid(Strength ~ Illusion_Type, scales = "free_y") +
  scale_colour_manual(values = group_col) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = group_col) +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = function(y) abs(y)) +
  coord_cartesian(xlim = c(0, 2.5)) +
  labs(x = "RT (s)",
       y = "Density: correct above, errors below (area = proportion of responses)",
       colour = NULL, fill = NULL,
       title = "Predicted RT distributions per group",
       caption = paste0(
         "Population level, mid task difficulty. Lines: posterior mean densities; bands: 95% intervals.\n",
         "Text: P(error), posterior mean (the area of the error curve). Each row has its own y scale.")) +
  theme_igsa
```

## Posterior predictive check

The model against the data. One hundred evenly spaced posterior draws
simulate a choice and a response time for every trial, with the participant
effects in (cogmod's `posterior_predict()` method), and the simulated trials are summarised
the way the observed ones are: the error rate and the median response time
in each pair of neighbouring strengths, pooled over difficulty and
participants; and, in three bands of strength (facilitating, strength ≤
−0.6; none, |strength| ≤ 0.3; conflicting, strength ≥ 0.6), the
distributions of correct and of erroneous response times, as histograms with
50 ms bins, each scaled by its share of responses. The summaries are written
to `analysis/results/ddm_ppc_*.csv`, which the paper draws from.

Why pairs: the two blocks of an illusion split the design. Block A shows the
odd tenths of strength (±0.1, ±0.3, …, ±0.9) with the four easier objective
differences (difficulty −1, −0.28, 0.31, 0.79), block B the even tenths
(±0.2, …, ±1) with the four harder ones (−0.62, 0.03, 0.56, 1). A curve per
strength therefore zigzags with difficulty (and block), in the data and in
the model alike. Each pair of neighbours (−1 and −0.9, …, 0.1 and 0.2, …,
0.9 and 1) takes one strength from each block, so it covers all eight
differences, and its point sits at the pair's mean strength.

```{r}
set.seed(1)
ppc_ids <- round(seq(1, ndraws(m), length.out = 100))
trials <- m$data
n_obs <- nrow(trials)
# posterior_predict() calls the family once per trial; cogmod's method also
# takes a vector of trials and returns their draws stacked, trial by trial
# (cogmod's ?rcogmod_ddm, "Predicting many observations at once"). Column 1
# is the response time, column 2 the choice (1 = the error boundary).
prep <- brms::prepare_predictions(m, draw_ids = ppc_ids)
for (dp in names(prep$dpars)) prep$dpars[[dp]] <- brms::get_dpar(prep, dp)
pp <- do.call(rbind, lapply(split(seq_len(n_obs), ceiling(seq_len(n_obs) / 50)),
                            cogmod::posterior_predict_cogmod_ddm, prep = prep))
stopifnot(nrow(pp) == length(ppc_ids) * n_obs)
rt_pred <- matrix(pp[, 1], nrow = length(ppc_ids))
ch_pred <- matrix(pp[, 2], nrow = length(ppc_ids))
stopifnot(all(ch_pred %in% c(0, 1)))
rm(pp, prep)

band <- function(s) ifelse(s <= -0.6, "Facilitating", ifelse(s >= 0.6, "Conflicting", ifelse(abs(s) <= 0.3, "None", NA)))
trials$Bin <- band(trials$Illusion_Strength)
cell <- paste(trials$Group, trials$Illusion_Type, trials$Bin, sep = "|")
cells <- unique(cell[!is.na(trials$Bin)])
# Defective histograms: 50 ms bins (three frames at 60 Hz) up to 2.5 s, the
# density of each response among all responses, so the two areas sum to the
# share of responses below 2.5 s. RT is the bin's centre.
breaks <- seq(0, 2.5, by = 0.05)
tgrid <- breaks[-1] - diff(breaks) / 2
defective <- function(rt, err) {
  n <- length(rt)
  lapply(c(Correct = 0, Error = 1), function(r) {
    x <- rt[err == r]
    tabulate(findInterval(x, breaks), nbins = length(tgrid)) / n / diff(breaks)
  })
}
ppc_dens <- do.call(rbind, lapply(cells, function(k) {
  parts <- strsplit(k, "|", fixed = TRUE)[[1]]
  i <- which(cell == k)
  observed <- defective(trials$RT[i], trials$Error[i])
  per_draw <- lapply(seq_along(ppc_ids), function(j) defective(rt_pred[j, i], ch_pred[j, i]))
  do.call(rbind, lapply(c("Correct", "Error"), function(r) {
    M <- do.call(rbind, lapply(per_draw, `[[`, r))
    data.frame(Group = parts[1], Illusion_Type = parts[2], Bin = parts[3], Response = r, N = length(i),
               RT = tgrid, Observed = observed[[r]], Pred_mean = colMeans(M),
               Pred_low = apply(M, 2, quantile, 0.025), Pred_high = apply(M, 2, quantile, 0.975))
  }))
}))
write.csv(ppc_dens, file.path(out_dir, "ddm_ppc_densities.csv"), row.names = FALSE)

ppc_errs <- do.call(rbind, lapply(cells, function(k) {
  parts <- strsplit(k, "|", fixed = TRUE)[[1]]
  i <- which(cell == k)
  p <- rowMeans(ch_pred[, i, drop = FALSE])
  data.frame(Group = parts[1], Illusion_Type = parts[2], Bin = parts[3], N = length(i),
             Observed = mean(trials$Error[i]), Pred_mean = mean(p),
             Pred_low = quantile(p, 0.025), Pred_high = quantile(p, 0.975))
}))
write.csv(ppc_errs, file.path(out_dir, "ddm_ppc_errors.csv"), row.names = FALSE)

# Pairs of neighbouring strengths (see above): -1 and -0.9 -> -0.95, ...,
# 0.1 and 0.2 -> 0.15, ..., 0.9 and 1 -> 0.95.
strength_pair <- function(s) sign(s) * (2 * floor((round(10 * abs(s)) - 1) / 2) + 1.5) / 10
stopifnot(length(unique(strength_pair(trials$Illusion_Strength))) == 10)
key <- paste(trials$Group, trials$Illusion_Type, strength_pair(trials$Illusion_Strength), sep = "|")
ppc_curves <- do.call(rbind, lapply(unique(key), function(k) {
  parts <- strsplit(k, "|", fixed = TRUE)[[1]]
  i <- which(key == k)
  e <- rowMeans(ch_pred[, i, drop = FALSE])
  r <- apply(rt_pred[, i, drop = FALSE], 1, median)
  head <- data.frame(Group = parts[1], Illusion_Type = parts[2], Illusion_Strength = as.numeric(parts[3]), N = length(i))
  rbind(
    cbind(head, Measure = "Error rate", Observed = mean(trials$Error[i]), Pred_mean = mean(e),
          Pred_low = quantile(e, 0.025), Pred_high = quantile(e, 0.975)),
    cbind(head, Measure = "Median RT (s)", Observed = median(trials$RT[i]), Pred_mean = mean(r),
          Pred_low = quantile(r, 0.025), Pred_high = quantile(r, 0.975)))
}))
write.csv(ppc_curves, file.path(out_dir, "ddm_ppc_curves.csv"), row.names = FALSE)
rm(rt_pred, ch_pred)
```

Overall, the simulated trials have an error rate of
`r sprintf("%.1f%%", 100 * weighted.mean(ppc_errs$Pred_mean, ppc_errs$N))` against
`r sprintf("%.1f%%", 100 * weighted.mean(ppc_errs$Observed, ppc_errs$N))` observed in
the same bands.

```{r}
#| fig-width: 9
#| fig-height: 5

cv <- ppc_curves
cv$Illusion_Type <- factor(illusions[as.character(cv$Illusion_Type)], levels = illusions)
cv$Group <- factor(cv$Group, levels = names(group_col))
ggplot(cv, aes(Illusion_Strength)) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, colour = "#9a9a95", linewidth = 0.4) +
  geom_ribbon(aes(ymin = Pred_low, ymax = Pred_high, fill = Group), alpha = 0.25) +
  geom_line(aes(y = Pred_mean, colour = Group), linewidth = 0.6) +
  geom_point(aes(y = Observed, colour = Group), size = 1.2) +
  facet_grid(Measure ~ Illusion_Type, scales = "free_y", switch = "y") +
  scale_colour_manual(values = group_col) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = group_col) +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = c(-1, 0, 1)) +
  labs(x = "Illusion strength", y = NULL, colour = NULL, fill = NULL,
       title = "Observed summaries and posterior predictions across strength",
       caption = paste0("Points: observed, per pair of neighbouring strengths, pooled over difficulty and participants.\n",
                        "Lines and bands: posterior predictive mean and 95% interval.")) +
  theme_igsa + theme(strip.placement = "outside")
```

```{r}
#| fig-width: 9
#| fig-height: 8

bin_lab <- c(Facilitating = "Facilitating illusion", None = "No illusion", Conflicting = "Conflicting illusion")
x <- ppc_dens
sgn <- ifelse(x$Response == "Error", -1, 1)
lo <- sgn * x$Pred_low; hi <- sgn * x$Pred_high
x$Observed <- sgn * x$Observed
x$Pred_mean <- sgn * x$Pred_mean
x$Pred_low <- pmin(lo, hi); x$Pred_high <- pmax(lo, hi)
x$Bin <- factor(bin_lab[x$Bin], levels = bin_lab)
x$Illusion_Type <- factor(illusions[as.character(x$Illusion_Type)], levels = illusions)
x$Group <- factor(x$Group, levels = names(group_col))
e <- ppc_errs
e$Bin <- factor(bin_lab[e$Bin], levels = bin_lab)
e$Illusion_Type <- factor(illusions[as.character(e$Illusion_Type)], levels = illusions)
e$Group <- factor(e$Group, levels = names(group_col))
e$Label <- sprintf("%s: %.0f%% (%.0f%%)", e$Group, 100 * e$Observed, 100 * e$Pred_mean)
top <- tapply(pmax(x$Pred_high, x$Observed), list(x$Bin, x$Illusion_Type), max)
bottom <- tapply(pmin(x$Pred_low, x$Observed), list(x$Bin, x$Illusion_Type), min)
ix <- cbind(as.character(e$Bin), as.character(e$Illusion_Type))
e$y <- top[ix] - 0.11 * (top - bottom)[ix] * (as.integer(e$Group) - 1)

ggplot(x, aes(RT, group = interaction(Group, Response))) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, colour = "#9a9a95", linewidth = 0.4) +
  geom_ribbon(aes(ymin = Pred_low, ymax = Pred_high, fill = Group), alpha = 0.25) +
  geom_line(aes(y = Pred_mean, colour = Group), linewidth = 0.5) +
  geom_point(aes(y = Observed, colour = Group), size = 0.6) +
  geom_text(data = e, aes(x = 2.45, y = y, label = Label, colour = Group), inherit.aes = FALSE,
            hjust = 1, size = 2.6, show.legend = FALSE) +
  facet_grid(Bin ~ Illusion_Type, scales = "free_y") +
  scale_colour_manual(values = group_col) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = group_col) +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = function(y) abs(y)) +
  coord_cartesian(xlim = c(0, 2.5)) +
  labs(x = "Response time (s)", y = "Density: correct above, errors below", colour = NULL, fill = NULL,
       title = "Observed and posterior predictive RT distributions",
       caption = paste0("Points: observed (50 ms bins). Lines and bands: posterior predictive mean and 95% interval.\n",
                        "Text: error rate, observed (predicted).")) +
  theme_igsa
```

## Group differences across strength

```{r}
plot_contrasts <- function(x, title) {
  ggplot(x, aes(Illusion_Strength, Median)) +
    geom_hline(yintercept = 0, colour = "#9a9a95", linewidth = 0.4) +
    geom_ribbon(aes(ymin = CI_low, ymax = CI_high, fill = Contrast), alpha = 0.12) +
    geom_line(aes(colour = Contrast, linetype = Contrast), linewidth = 0.7) +
    facet_grid(Quantity ~ Illusion_Type, scales = "free_y", switch = "y") +
    scale_colour_manual(values = contrast_col) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = contrast_col) +
    scale_linetype_manual(values = contrast_lty) +
    scale_x_continuous(breaks = c(-1, 0, 1)) +
    labs(x = "Illusion strength", y = "Difference between groups",
         colour = NULL, fill = NULL, linetype = NULL, title = title, caption = caption) +
    theme_igsa + theme(strip.placement = "outside")
}
```

```{r}
#| fig-width: 9
#| fig-height: 11

plot_contrasts(contrasts[contrasts$Quantity %in% quantities[setdiff(parameters, "mu")], ],
               "Group differences in the DDM parameters")
```

```{r}
#| fig-width: 9
#| fig-height: 7.5

plot_contrasts(contrasts[contrasts$Quantity %in% quantities[derived], ],
               "Group differences in discriminability and P(error)")
```

## With no illusion, and in its effect

The two numbers per contrast that the curves come down to: the difference at
strength 0, and the difference in the change from strength 0 to 1 (the
strongest conflicting illusion).

```{r}
#| fig-width: 9
#| fig-height: 16

summary_tab$Measure <- factor(summary_tab$Measure, levels = unique(summary_tab$Measure))
summary_tab$Illusion_Type <- factor(summary_tab$Illusion_Type, levels = rev(illusions))
# Dodged bottom-up, so reverse the groups to read top-down in legend order.
summary_tab$Dodge <- factor(summary_tab$Contrast, levels = rev(levels(summary_tab$Contrast)))

ggplot(summary_tab, aes(Median, Illusion_Type, colour = Contrast, group = Dodge)) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, colour = "#9a9a95", linewidth = 0.4) +
  geom_linerange(aes(xmin = CI_low, xmax = CI_high), linewidth = 0.7,
                 position = position_dodge(width = 0.6)) +
  geom_point(aes(shape = Contrast), size = 2.2, position = position_dodge(width = 0.6)) +
  facet_wrap(~ Quantity + Measure, scales = "free_x", ncol = 2,
             labeller = function(l) label_value(l, multi_line = FALSE)) +
  scale_colour_manual(values = contrast_col) +
  scale_shape_manual(values = c("Past - Never" = 16, "Recent - Never" = 17, "Recent - Past" = 15)) +
  labs(x = "Difference between groups (median, 95% interval)", y = NULL, colour = NULL,
       shape = NULL, title = "Group differences per illusion: with no illusion, and in its effect",
       caption = "Population level, mid task difficulty. Effect of the illusion: the change from strength 0 to 1 (the strongest conflicting illusion).") +
  theme_igsa + theme(strip.text = element_text(face = "bold", hjust = 0, size = 8))
```

```{r}
hits <- summary_tab[summary_tab$pd >= 0.95, ]
hits$Illusion_Type <- factor(hits$Illusion_Type, levels = illusions)
hits <- hits[order(hits$Measure, hits$Quantity, hits$Contrast, hits$Illusion_Type), ]
```

The `r nrow(hits)` contrasts (of `r nrow(summary_tab)`) whose probability of
direction is at least 0.95:

```{r}
knitr::kable(
  hits[c("Measure", "Quantity", "Contrast", "Illusion_Type", "Median", "CI_low", "CI_high", "pd")],
  digits = c(NA, NA, NA, NA, 3, 3, 3, 3), row.names = FALSE,
  col.names = c("Measure", "Quantity", "Contrast", "Illusion", "Median", "2.5%", "97.5%", "pd")
)
```

## Averaged over the design

One number per parameter and contrast: the group difference averaged over
every strength × difficulty point the task showed (80 per illusion), per
illusion and across the three. For the parameters it is
`modelbased::estimate_contrasts()` on the fit, predicting each distributional
parameter at the population level over that grid; for the derived quantities
it is the same average of the per-draw grid in `marginals.R`, and the two are
checked against each other on the parameters. The design has mean strength 0,
with strength orthogonal to difficulty, so for the drift (identity link)
the average is the value at strength 0 and the design's mean difficulty
(0.098, a little hard of the midpoint used above). For the other
parameters (log, softplus and logit links) and for P(error) it is a genuine average, and the P(error) one
should sit close to the raw error-rate differences in `0_preprocessing.qmd`.

```{r}
design <- igsa_design_grid(m)

mb_contrasts <- function(x) {
  x <- as.data.frame(x)
  data.frame(Contrast = paste(x$Level1, "-", x$Level2),
             Illusion_Type = if ("Illusion_Type" %in% names(x)) as.character(x$Illusion_Type) else "All",
             Median = x$Median, CI_low = x$CI_low, CI_high = x$CI_high, pd = x$pd)
}
averaged <- do.call(rbind, lapply(parameters, function(p) rbind(
  cbind(Quantity = p, mb_contrasts(estimate_contrasts(m, contrast = "Group", by = "Illusion_Type",
                                                      newdata = design, predict = p, re_formula = NA))),
  cbind(Quantity = p, mb_contrasts(estimate_contrasts(m, contrast = "Group",
                                                      newdata = design, predict = p, re_formula = NA)))
)))

# The derived quantities the same way, per draw.
dd <- igsa_draws(m, design)
dd$poutlier <- NULL
cols <- c("Quantity", "Contrast", "Illusion_Type", "Median", "CI_low", "CI_high", "pd")
b_ill <- igsa_summary(igsa_contrasts(igsa_average(dd, design)))
b_all <- igsa_summary(igsa_contrasts(igsa_average(dd, design, by = "Group")))
b_all$Illusion_Type <- "All"
# The per-group values behind the contrasts, for the paper.
a_ill <- igsa_summary(igsa_average(dd, design))
a_all <- igsa_summary(igsa_average(dd, design, by = "Group"))
a_all$Illusion_Type <- "All"
mean_cols <- c("Group", "Illusion_Type", "Quantity", "Median", "CI_low", "CI_high", "pd")
write.csv(rbind(a_ill[mean_cols], a_all[mean_cols]), file.path(out_dir, "ddm_groups_averaged_means.csv"), row.names = FALSE)
bespoke <- rbind(b_ill[cols], b_all[cols])
bespoke$Illusion_Type <- as.character(bespoke$Illusion_Type)

# Same draws, same grid, same average: the two code paths must agree.
check <- merge(averaged, bespoke, by = c("Quantity", "Contrast", "Illusion_Type"), suffixes = c("_mb", "_r"))
stopifnot(nrow(check) == nrow(averaged), max(abs(check$Median_mb - check$Median_r)) < 1e-6)

averaged <- rbind(averaged[cols], bespoke[bespoke$Quantity %in% derived, cols])
write.csv(averaged, file.path(out_dir, "ddm_groups_averaged.csv"), row.names = FALSE)
```

```{r}
plot_dots <- function(x, title, caption, ncol = 2) {
  lab <- ifelse(x$Quantity %in% names(quantities), quantities[as.character(x$Quantity)], as.character(x$Quantity))
  x$Quantity <- factor(lab, levels = unique(lab))
  ill <- c(illusions, All = "All illusions")
  x$Illusion_Type <- factor(ill[as.character(x$Illusion_Type)], levels = c(rev(illusions), "All illusions"))
  x$Contrast <- factor(x$Contrast, levels = names(contrast_col))
  x$Dodge <- factor(x$Contrast, levels = rev(levels(x$Contrast)))
  ggplot(x, aes(Median, Illusion_Type, colour = Contrast, group = Dodge)) +
    geom_vline(xintercept = 0, colour = "#9a9a95", linewidth = 0.4) +
    geom_linerange(aes(xmin = CI_low, xmax = CI_high), linewidth = 0.7,
                   position = position_dodge(width = 0.6)) +
    geom_point(aes(shape = Contrast), size = 2.2, position = position_dodge(width = 0.6)) +
    facet_wrap(~ Quantity, scales = "free_x", ncol = ncol) +
    scale_colour_manual(values = contrast_col) +
    scale_shape_manual(values = c("Past - Never" = 16, "Recent - Never" = 17, "Recent - Past" = 15)) +
    labs(x = "Difference between groups (median, 95% interval)", y = NULL, colour = NULL,
         shape = NULL, title = title, caption = caption) +
    theme_igsa + theme(strip.text = element_text(face = "bold", hjust = 0, size = 8))
}
```

```{r}

#| fig-height: 9

plot_dots(averaged, "Group differences averaged over the design",
          "Population level, averaged over every strength x difficulty point shown. For the drift this is the value at strength 0 and the mean difficulty of the design.")
```

```{r}
all_tab$Quantity <- quantities[as.character(all_tab$Quantity)]
knitr::kable(all_tab[c("Quantity", "Contrast", "Median", "CI_low", "CI_high", "pd")],
```

## Slopes: strength, difficulty and the illusion index

The marginal effect of illusion strength and of task difficulty on each
parameter, per group and illusion, at strength 0 and mid difficulty
(`modelbased::estimate_slopes()`: the derivative at that point, which for
the drift is the whole slope since the surface is linear, and for the
other parameters the local slope on their natural scale). Their group
contrasts come from the kept posterior iterations. Then, from the per-draw
grid, the two slopes of discriminability and their ratio, the **illusion
magnitude**: how many units of difficulty one unit of strength costs, the PSE
shift in stimulus units, which nothing that scales the whole surface can
change (`igsa_index()` in `marginals.R`).

```{r}
grid00 <- igsa_grid(m, strength = 0, difficulty = 0)
trend_lab <- c(Illusion_Strength = "strength", Task_Difficulty = "difficulty")

slope_of <- function(p, v) {
  s <- as.data.frame(estimate_slopes(m, trend = v, by = c("Group", "Illusion_Type"), newdata = grid00,
                                     predict = p, re_formula = NA, keep_iterations = TRUE))
  iterations <- t(as.matrix(s[grep("^iter_", names(s))]))
  g <- data.frame(Group = as.character(s$Group), Illusion_Type = as.character(s$Illusion_Type))
  means <- data.frame(Quantity = p, Trend = trend_lab[[v]], g, Median = s$Median,
                      CI_low = s$CI_low, CI_high = s$CI_high, pd = s$pd)
  ctr <- igsa_summary(igsa_contrasts(list(slope = iterations), g))
  ctr <- data.frame(Quantity = p, Trend = trend_lab[[v]],
                    ctr[c("Contrast", "Illusion_Type", "Median", "CI_low", "CI_high", "pd")])
  list(means = means, contrasts = ctr)
}
sl <- unlist(lapply(parameters, function(p) lapply(names(trend_lab), function(v) slope_of(p, v))),
             recursive = FALSE)
slope_means <- do.call(rbind, lapply(sl, `[[`, "means"))
slope_contrasts <- do.call(rbind, lapply(sl, `[[`, "contrasts"))

# For the drift the derivative is the 0-to-1 change of the earlier
# section, on the same draws: check it.
check <- merge(igsa_summary(igsa_slopes(d, grid, from = 0, to = 1), what = "mu"),
               slope_means[slope_means$Quantity == "mu" & slope_means$Trend == "strength", ],
               by = c("Group", "Illusion_Type"))
stopifnot(nrow(check) == 9, max(abs(check$Median.x - check$Median.y)) < 1e-5)

# The illusion index, from the per-draw grid.
g4 <- igsa_grid(m, strength = c(0, 1), difficulty = c(0, 1))
ix <- igsa_index(igsa_draws(m, g4), g4)
index_means <- igsa_summary(ix)
index_contrasts <- igsa_summary(igsa_contrasts(ix))
index_lab <- c(delta_strength = "v ~ strength (illusion effect)",
               delta_difficulty = "v ~ difficulty (precision)",
               index = "Illusion magnitude: strength / difficulty")

slopes_out <- rbind(
  data.frame(slope_means[c("Quantity", "Trend", "Group")], Contrast = NA,
             slope_means[c("Illusion_Type", "Median", "CI_low", "CI_high", "pd")]),
  data.frame(slope_contrasts[c("Quantity", "Trend")], Group = NA,
             slope_contrasts[c("Contrast", "Illusion_Type", "Median", "CI_low", "CI_high", "pd")]),
  data.frame(Quantity = index_means$Quantity, Trend = NA, Group = index_means$Group, Contrast = NA,
             index_means[c("Illusion_Type", "Median", "CI_low", "CI_high", "pd")]),
  data.frame(Quantity = index_contrasts$Quantity, Trend = NA, Group = NA,
             index_contrasts[c("Contrast", "Illusion_Type", "Median", "CI_low", "CI_high", "pd")])
)
write.csv(slopes_out, file.path(out_dir, "ddm_groups_slopes.csv"), row.names = FALSE)
```

The index per group and illusion (median, 95% interval), and its group
differences:

```{r}
fmt <- function(x) sprintf("%.2f [%.2f, %.2f]", x$Median, x$CI_low, x$CI_high)
im <- index_means[index_means$Quantity == "index", ]
im$Value <- fmt(im)
im$Illusion <- illusions[as.character(im$Illusion_Type)]
im_wide <- stats::reshape(im[c("Illusion", "Group", "Value")], idvar = "Illusion",
                          timevar = "Group", direction = "wide")
names(im_wide) <- sub("^Value\\.", "", names(im_wide))
knitr::kable(im_wide, row.names = FALSE)

ic <- index_contrasts[index_contrasts$Quantity == "index", ]
ic$Value <- fmt(ic)
ic$Illusion <- illusions[as.character(ic$Illusion_Type)]
ic$pd <- round(ic$pd, 3)
knitr::kable(ic[c("Contrast", "Illusion", "Value", "pd")], row.names = FALSE,
             col.names = c("Contrast", "Illusion", "Difference", "pd"))
```

```{r}
#| fig-width: 9
#| fig-height: 15

slopes_fig <- rbind(
  data.frame(Quantity = paste(quantities[slope_contrasts$Quantity], "~", slope_contrasts$Trend),
             slope_contrasts[c("Contrast", "Illusion_Type", "Median", "CI_low", "CI_high", "pd")]),
  data.frame(Quantity = index_lab[index_contrasts$Quantity],
             index_contrasts[c("Contrast", "Illusion_Type", "Median", "CI_low", "CI_high", "pd")])
)
plot_dots(slopes_fig, "Group differences in the marginal slopes, and in the illusion magnitude",
          "Population level, at strength 0 and mid difficulty. Slopes: the derivative of the parameter per unit of strength or difficulty.")
```
